coordinate_system: Destinations relative to actual support/contact anchor unless explicitly airborne; uniform scales only.

angel.role_scale: Apply existing actor visual multiplier once, currently2x. Compare body mass at death transition; do not fit each frame separately.
angel.death: Immediately stop flight loop/attacks. Use frame0 dark eyes/limp wings during gravity fall, translated from current body center. On actual support contact use frame1 for.12s then frame2 permanently.
angel.landing_registration: Airborne anchor is body center; ground anchors are lowest opaque support. Reconcile body center through landing, no jump between origins.
angel.remains: Curled legs, collapsed white wings, dark eyes, fallen halo. No airborne frozen corpse; fall through pits if no support.

gratecrawler.death: Keep existing hurt/collapse lead-in then hold authored frame7 sludge-and-grate permanently; remove global alpha fade.
gratecrawler.remains: Actual collapsed sludge with fallen grate, not crouching living frame. Preserve existing registered baseline and role scale.

sewer_swarm.role_scale: Already final logical size: about65px wide×14px tall per cluster; do not multiply by living swarm128px footprint.

sewer_swarm.remains: Settled side/back bodies with curled legs and collapsed pale wings, no hover animation or oscillation. Maintain world position/support.
sewer_swarm.fall_registration: Do not instantly teleport airborne death to floor; individual dead components or descending cluster must visibly bridge death-to-contact.

shared.lifecycle: Persist using toilet-remains world lifecycle independent of removed combat actor. Clear on level reset, not0.6s death timer.
shared.physics: Harmless, no collision or platform support for hero, no attacks. Ground on actual existing platform/top surface; never leave floating wrecks.
shared.support_loss: If support is removed, fall again; never hover. If death occurs over pit, retain visible fall then cull below view.
shared.bounds: Use opaque extents; respect ledge support and avoid drawing through solids.
